column1: # Fuzz targets the CI `fuzz-smoke` job runs, and the ones it does not.
# scripts/ci/fuzz_smoke.py reads this file: it shards the `smoke` rows across the
# `fuzz-smoke-shard` matrix (row N goes to shard N mod shards, so shards differ by
# at most one target), runs each as `go test ./<package> -run '^$' -fuzz='^<target>$'
# -fuzztime=<fuzztime>`, and fails the check when a Fuzz function in the tree is in
# neither list or a row names a function that no longer exists.
# Columns (tab separated): status, package, target, fuzztime, timeout ("-" = Go's
#   smoke        run on every CI run.
#   unscheduled  exists in the tree and runs only as a seed-corpus test; not fuzzed in
#                CI. This list may only shrink (the script caps it).
